# Toova

> A 3D room planner that turns product photos into real-scale models so you can design a room before you buy.

Toova helps people place furniture and decor inside their own space at real scale. Start with a photo, get a 3D model in about thirty seconds, arrange it against your walls, then buy with confidence. Free for five rooms; Studio unlocks unlimited rooms.

## Key pages

- Homepage: https://toova.net/
- Gallery: https://toova.net/gallery
- Timeline: https://toova.net/timeline

## Product

- Photo → 3D conversion at real-world scale
- Measured dorm plans (student housing first)
- Free tier: up to 5 rooms
- Studio: $18/month for unlimited rooms and priority processing
